Task.title: Task
Task.description: A daily task and reminder item belonging to a user

userId.description: ID of the user who owns the task

title.description: Title or headline of the task

category.description: Category name: Work, Personal, Study, Health, Shopping, Other

reminderTimestamp.description: Scheduled reminder epoch time in milliseconds, 0 if none

isCompleted.description: Whether the task is marked as completed

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when task was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when task was last updated
